PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.name: 808 Beat Drop / Fatal Gunshot Synchronization
PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.description: Locking the primary musical drop (808 kick / trap snare) frame-accurately to the first lethal trigger pull.
PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.editing_technique: Timeline audio grid alignment ensuring music drop transient matches the exact weapon fire frame.
PAT_DROP_ref_ref_.suggested_audio_treatment: Sidechain gameplay audio so 808 transient dominates, weapon crack layered on top at +2.5 dB.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Audio Track 1 (CS2) Sidechained to Track 2 (Music), Ducking: -3.5dB on drop hit.

SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.name: Low-End Sub Downer & Metallic Headshot Dink
SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.description: Deep sub-bass impact (< 70 Hz) paired with a high-frequency metal snap on lethal headshot confirmations.
visual_prerequisites: Headshot kill confirmed in combat log
SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.editing_technique: Layering Sonniss GDC impact_sub_downer_fast16.wav (-4.0 dB) with accent_flicking_metal_snap.wav (-6.0 dB).
suggested_effects: Sub harmonic synthesizer / low-pass filter @ 80 Hz
High shelf boost @ 6 kHz on dink
SOUND_SUB_DOWNER_HEADSHOT.suggested_audio_treatment: Duck music soundtrack by -3.5 dB for 150ms to allow sub transient to hit cleanly.

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Fairlight Track A3 (Impacts): Level -4.0 dB, Bus 1 (Main Master)

SOUND_FAST_AIR_WHOOSH.name: Pre-Cut Fast Air Blast Whoosh
SOUND_FAST_AIR_WHOOSH.description: Aerodynamic designed whoosh preceding camera angle cuts or speed-ramps by 2-3 frames.
visual_prerequisites: Camera angle transition or whip pan
SOUND_FAST_AIR_WHOOSH.editing_technique: Sonniss GDC whoosh_air_blast_clean.wav aligned so peak volume occurs on cut boundary frame.
SOUND_FAST_AIR_WHOOSH.suggested_audio_treatment: Level at -8.0 dB, panning from left to center.
